Pre and post-monsoon comparison of the Western Ghats. The change in vegetation is astounding.
Monsoon is one of the best times to trek in the Western Ghats, but that is if you can brave the leeches and rain

This is what I miss most about Maharashtra. I used to frequently travel the Pune - Mahabaleshwar - Mahad and Pune - Bhor - Mahad routes.

Travelling in state transport buses meant that the trip could take upto 5 hours, but the scenery during monsoon more than made up for it. The way the ghats filled with greenery was always so refreshing.

It's true, you never realize something's importance until you lose it. Now I'm in Chennai which doesn't even have a decent monsoon season. All I can think of are those green mountains filled with the smell rain and clouds descending down the slopes.

But really, most of Reddit's content comes from finding it some other place on the web anyways.
